units.text: Japan's population was 123,802,000 as of October 1, 2024, according to official estimates from the Statistics Bureau, Japan.

citations.title: Statistics Bureau Home Page/Population Estimates/Current Population Estimates as of October 1, 2024

judgement.reason: The Statistics Bureau page states the total population was 123,802 thousand as of October 1, 2024, which equals 123,802,000.

units.text: The Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications reported the same population figure of 123,802,000 for Japan as of October 1, 2024.

citations.title: Japan’s Population Declines for Fourteenth Straight Year: Over-75 Cohort Continues to Grow | Nippon.com

judgement.reason: The passage states the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications estimated Japan's total population as 123,802,000 as of October 1, 2024, matching the statement.
